Models in levels, from the economy to indust"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"ries and companies, fill in the paths and reprice positions; each model and asse"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# MacroStress"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | Русский | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"MacroStress answers one question: what happens to a portfolio if a given event occurs. A person
stat"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"es only the event, in words: "the central bank raises the policy rate to 21 % and holds it
for a yea"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"r", or "fertiliser exports are banned". An LLM agent turns the event into a scenario, a
formal recor"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"d the models can compute, using a corpus of sources known at the calculation date:
news, regulator d"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"ecisions, descriptions of past episodes. The person checks and approves the
scenario. The models the"},{"id":"p4s6","text":"n simulate the economy under it, level by level, and reprice every
position on the same paths. The r"},{"id":"p4s7","text":"esult is the distribution of portfolio losses month by month."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The platform itself names no model: macro models, satellite models and asset types are plugins,
and "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"a new one is a package added without edits to the core. The agent works through MCP; every
step is a"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" package added without edits to the core. The agent works through MCP; every
step is also a command."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Event and scenario"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"An event is what a person expects to happen, said in words and possibly without numbers. The
models "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"cannot compute words: they need to know which paths are allowed, which shocks produce
them, and what"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" lies outside the models. The agent writes this down as a scenario
$s=(N,m,O,D,\mathcal C)$:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Part | What it holds | For "the policy rate stays at 21 % for a year" |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| $N$ | the event in text, with links to the sources of its numbers | the text and the regulator's p"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"ress release |
| $m$ | the model versions the scenario is computed on | the current macro and satell"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ite versions |
| $\mathcal C$ | conditions on the paths of any level: a value with a tolerance, a ra"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"nge, a mean or a probability | the policy rate between 20.5 % and 21.5 % in months 1 to 12 |
| $D$ |"},{"id":"p10s5","text":" causes: the model shocks allowed to produce the event | the monetary policy shock |
| $O$ | impacts"},{"id":"p10s6","text":": shifts of a level's path for effects the models lack | none; for an export ban, the fall in one in"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"vel's path for effects the models lack | none; for an export ban, the fall in one industry's sales |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Every number in $\mathcal C$ and $O$ is labelled by its origin: the event itself, a named source,
or"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" an explicit assumption. If the event leaves the direction of a move open, the agent writes one
scen"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"ario per direction, and each is computed separately. The agent does not start the
calculation until "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"the person approves the scenario."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The platform changes the distribution of the causes $D$ as little as possible so that the
conditions"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" $\mathcal C$ hold, then adds the impacts $O$. The size of that change,
$\mathrm{dist}(s)=\mathrm{KL"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"}(P_s\Vert P)$, is reported as the scenario price: the higher it is,
the less the scenario agrees wi"},{"id":"p12s4","text":", is reported as the scenario price: the higher it is,
the less the scenario agrees with the models."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Levels of the economy"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Quantities are split into levels $l=0,\dots,L$, from the general to the particular: for example
the "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"economy, an industry, a company. Each level has its own model, which takes the paths of the
levels a"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"bove it as inputs. The last level holds the target indicators."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Level | Model | Example quantities |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| $0$ | macro model: joint paths of the macro variables | policy rate, inflation, exchange rate, out"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"put |
| $1,\dots,L$ | satellite model of the level: its quantities from the levels above plus its ow"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"n noise | overdue loans of an industry, a company's share price, a bond spread, housing prices |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The definitions are in docs/concept/formalization.en.md."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Plugins"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Kind | What it models | Shipped examples |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| macro | level 0: shocks and paths of the macro variables | `bvar.sv`, a Bayesian VAR with stochast"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ic volatility; `msvar.markov`, a VAR with Markov-switching regimes |
| satellite | a level above 0: "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"its quantities from the paths of the levels above | `hier.gibbs`, a hierarchical regression, the def"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"ault for every quantity; `reflevel2.regression`, a reference second level |
| position | an asset ty"},{"id":"p21s5","text":"pe: the value of a position on the paths | `equity`, `bond`, `credit` (loans and deposits), `housing"},{"id":"p21s6","text":" the value of a position on the paths | `equity`, `bond`, `credit` (loans and deposits), `housing` |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The macro model is chosen when it is estimated. A quantity goes to the satellite model that
declares"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" it, or to the one named explicitly. A position goes to the plugin of its asset type.
Every shipped "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"plugin describes its model in `REFERENCE.en.md` next to the code."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The platform finds a plugin in `mst.plugins`, through an entry point of the group `mst.plugins`,
or "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"in a directory listed in `MST_PLUGINS_PATH`. The guide is
docs/howto/plugins.en.md."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"The shipped models are examples under development and change between releases. The episode
backtest "},{"id":"p25s2","text":"scores every version on historical events against a random walk with drift. Its
episodes and the oth"},{"id":"p25s3","text":"er check sets with known answers are in bench/."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Data"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"The series, their sources and release lags are configuration: `src/mst/data/sources.toml`, the
varia"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"ble registry `src/mst/macro/registry.toml` and the driver registry
`src/mst/drivers/registry.toml`. "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"The shipped set is a sample. Every value keeps its release
date, so a model estimated as of a date s"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ees only what was published by then. Data are not part
of the repository; you download them under ea"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"published by then. Data are not part
of the repository; you download them under each source's terms."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Output"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"For every month of the horizon: quantiles of the target indicators and of the portfolio loss
($P_5$,"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" $P_{50}$, $P_{95}$), ES95 (the mean loss over the worst 5 % of paths) and the scenario
price. The r"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"everse search answers the opposite question: the worst loss among scenarios no
dearer than a given p"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"rice, or the cheapest scenario that reaches a given loss."}],"truncated":true}
